description:
Welcome to The Legacy! Furnished 2 bedroom/1 bathroom condo in the heart of Downtown Edmonton.

Spacious 2 bed/1 bath unit located in Downtown Edmonton one block south of 104 Avenue along 105 Street. The apartment is fully furnished including in-suite newer washer and dryer, 70” Sony TV, dishwasher, two beds or [one bed and one desk if you want the second bedroom to be an office], dressers, etc; kitchen and living room furnishings.The kitchen has been renovated and contains ceramic tile floor, upgraded large quartz counter tops, new kitchen appliances, under cabinet lighting, custom built walnut cabinets. All windows have blinds, and there are blackout blinds in the bedrooms. The unit is an end unit, so only 1 neighbor along the north wall. The walls and floor are concrete so it is a very quiet unit. This is easily one of the best units in the Legacy! The Legacy has a Gym and bike lockup room on the main floor. Building Management is great and the caretaker lives on site.

Located on the 12th Floor with balcony overlooking Rogers Place, great for Oilers playoff runs. One secured underground parking stall included with visitor parking behind the building. Fob secured access to enter the covered parking.
If you are a student or professional, Bay/Enterprise LRT station is a couple blocks away and the complex is close to several major bus routes. Short walk to several great coffee shops and restaurants located on 104th Street Promenade, Rogers Place in your backyard, Ice District, and City Market grocery store. Perfect for students and working professionals! Short walk from the beautiful Edmonton River Valley and City Centre Mall. There is also a large park currently under construction on 107 Street that will be close and there is another park already built on 105 Street.

The Unit is available March 2026. Currently accepting 1 year lease terms at $1,800/month includes: heat, water, electricity, and underground parking stall (not heated). Five minutes drive to Hwy 417 (Terry Fox Exit) and Kanata Centrum,

10 minutes drive to Kanata North Technology Park,

10 minutes drive to DND campus at Carling and Moodie (Old Nortel Campus)

All appliances included: Washer, dryer, electric stove, Fridge and a dish washer.  Hood fan with air vented outside.

title: 105 Cherryhill Blvd, 160 Cherryhill Place, 200 & 201 Westfield D
description: Cherryhil Village is an inviting 12 building community in west London, less than 15 minutes to Western University. Enjoy spacious, pet friendly suites with heat included, in-building laundry and plenty of storage space, security controlled access, private balconies, in and outdoor parking, a fitness centre, BBQ area, in and outdoor pool, sauna and tennis courts. These apartment rentals are close to numerous amenities for an active, full lifestyle. Getting groceries is simple at nearby Bulk Barrel, Oxford Street Valu-mart, Sobeys Extra or Metro, and you’ll have your choice of Victoria Public School, Eagle Heights Public School or Jeanne Sauvé French Immersion Public School. Nearby healthcare facilities include the St. Joseph’s Hospital, Mount Health Centre for Long Term Care and Fowler Kennedy Sport Medicine Clinic. This group of apartments surrounding Cherryhill Village Mall include: 105 Cherryhill Blvd, 115 Cherryhill Blvd, 120 Cherryhill Place, 140 Cherryhill Place, 160 Cherryhill Place, 110 Cherryhill Circle; 170 Cherryhill Circle, 180 Cherryhill Circle, 190 Cherryhill Circle, 200 Westfield Drive, 201 Westfield Drive, and 230 Platt's Lane. Excellent Transit & Connectivity: The Cherryhill Village area is well-served by London Transit bus routes, providing easy access to Western University, Fanshawe College, and downtown London. Major roadways such as Oxford Street and Wharncliffe Road offer quick connections to Highway 401 and other parts of the city. Shopping & Dining at Your Doorstep: Residents enjoy direct access to Cherryhill Village Mall, which features grocery stores, banks, pharmacies, and a wide range of shops and services. For dining, the neighborhood offers an array of options including casual eateries, cafés, and restaurants with international cuisines. Downtown London’s bustling dining and entertainment scene is just a short drive away. Parks & Recreation: The neighborhood is surrounded by green spaces, with Thames Valley Parkway, Springbank Park, and Gibbons Park nearby for walking, cycling, and picnicking. Community recreation centers and fitness facilities in the area provide additional options for staying active year-round. Schools & Education: Families will appreciate the proximity to excellent public and Catholic schools, as well as childcare services. Students benefit from being just minutes away from Western University and Fanshawe College, both of which are easily accessible by public transit. A Friendly & Well-Established Community: Cherryhill Village is known for its mature tree-lined streets, quiet residential atmosphere, and welcoming community feel. With amenities designed to meet a wide range of needs, the area is perfect for residents of all ages. Your Ideal London
